svg.title: Load balancing
svg.desc: Phones send a mix of slow uploads and fast feed views to a load balancer with three servers. With round robin, every upload happens to land on server 1, and feed views wait in line behind them. With least connections, each request goes to the server with the fewest in progress, so the uploads spread out and feed views wait far less.
svg.text: Round robin stacks slow uploads on server 1. Least connections spreads them.
